headline: Fee revenue flat, investment gains drive profit surge
summary_short: Hamilton Lane's quarter ended March 31, 2026 posted revenue of $193.6M (-2.2% y/y), roughly flat, while net income jumped 31.0% y/y to $66.2M on investment gains rather than core fee growth.
summary_long: Revenue was $193.6M, down 2.2% y/y, as fee revenue for this quarter didn't track the fiscal year's overall growth; operating income also slipped 2.1% y/y to $82.2M. Net income, EBIT and EBITDA all rose sharply (net income +31.0% y/y to $66.2M) -- a divergence the 10-K explains only at the full-fiscal-year level: equity-in-investees income grew $22.9M and Consolidated Fund investment gains grew $71.8M for FY2026, both non-operating. EBIT/EBITDA appear to include these non-operating gains, unlike the operating-income line. Cash rose to $371.9M (+31.1% y/y); long-term debt eased to $278.4M; equity grew to $915.2M (+27.6% y/y). No numeric forward guidance was disclosed in this 10-K.
